text: 🚨 The river is rising behind our street and water is entering the ground floors. Please avoid the bridge and follow the evacuation notice from local officials. #Flood #StaySafe
Our neighborhood needs bottled water, blankets, and phone chargers after the storm damaged several homes. If you are safe and able to help, meet at the community center. #DisasterRelief
A wildfire is moving toward the north side of town. Fire crews are asking everyone nearby to leave now and use the east road. Please share this evacuation update. 🔥 #Wildfire
The earthquake shook our apartment building hard. We are outside in the open area with our neighbors, and emergency teams are checking for damage. Please let family know we are safe. #Earthquake
Severe flooding has closed the road by the school. A family is stranded near the bus stop and needs rescue support. We have called emergency services. 🚨 #FloodRescue
The hurricane warning has been upgraded for our coast. We packed medication and important documents and are heading to the shelter before roads get crowded. Please check on older neighbors.
If anyone can reach the south block, residents there are asking for help getting out as the water keeps rising. Rescue boats are heading that way now. 🙏 #Emergency #Flood
A tornado damaged several houses near the county line. Please stay away from the area so emergency crews can work, and report anyone who needs assistance to the response team.
Smoke is covering the highway after a brush fire jumped the road. Officials say to evacuate the nearby homes immediately and keep the route clear for firefighters. 🔥 #EvacuateNow
The landslide blocked the only road into our village after hours of heavy rain. Several people are waiting for medical supplies, and local responders are working to reopen access.
We felt a strong earthquake and part of the ceiling came down. Everyone is outside and accounted for, but our neighbor may be trapped upstairs. Calling for help now. #EarthquakeRelief
Emergency shelter is open at the high school for families displaced by the apartment fire. Bring essential medicine if you can, and message the volunteer desk if you need transport.
Flash flood warning for the valley: water is crossing the road and moving fast. Do not drive through it. Turn around and move to higher ground now. 🌧️ #FloodWarning
Power lines are down after last night's windstorm and several streets remain unsafe. Crews are on the way; please keep a safe distance and report hazards to the utility company.
A building collapsed after the explosion downtown. Rescue teams are searching the area, and nearby residents should move away from the scene. Please avoid sharing unconfirmed names. #Emergency
The river overflowed overnight and water reached the first floor of our home. We are at the shelter now, but our elderly neighbors still need help leaving. Can someone contact the rescue team?
The coastal evacuation order is active for our district. Pack essentials, check on people who need assistance, and follow official routes. 🌀 #Hurricane #Evacuation
A winter storm has left several families without heat after trees brought down power lines. The warming center is open tonight; call the local help line if you need a ride.
Our town is asking for donations of clean water and canned food after the wildfire evacuation. Drop-off is at the library parking lot, away from the fire zone. ❤️ #CommunityRelief
A severe storm damaged the clinic roof and patients are being moved to the regional hospital. Please keep the access road clear for ambulances and emergency staff.
Sunday brunch with my favorite people, fresh waffles, and absolutely no plans for the afternoon. 🥞☀️ #WeekendMood
